## About these books

They began as blog posts, expanded into tutorials on
[Rsquared Academy](https://www.rsquaredacademy.com/), then collected and
rewritten into these short books. The writing style is deliberately plain —
short chapters, worked examples, and the parts of the documentation people
usually skip.

None of them replaces the official [R documentation](https://www.r-project.org/).
If you want one place to start, **Introduction to R** is the one.

If these were useful, the courses behind them are at
[rsquaredacademy.com](https://www.rsquaredacademy.com/).
